title: ChargeItemDefinition_PriceComponent
description: The ChargeItemDefinition resource provides the properties that apply to the (billing) codes necessary to calculate costs and prices. The properties may differ largely depending on type and realm, therefore this resource gives only a rough structure and requires profiling for each type of billing code system.

type.description: This code identifies the type of the component.

code.description: A code that identifies the component. Codes may be used to differentiate between kinds of taxes, surcharges, discounts etc.

factor.description: The factor that has been applied on the base price for calculating this component.

amount.description: The amount calculated for this component.
